dialog (Kick username + Twitter username, both optional, >=1 required) that
runs runCreatorCheck() from @/lib/creator-hub, saves the pulled data to the
ADMIN-DB substrate (kick_profiles/kick_streams/twitter_profiles/tweets/
twitter_mentions), and displays a box per previously-checked profile.

- Works for ANY handle (not only signed-up creators) — shares the same
  fetch+store services + substrate tables as the per-creator Kick/Twitter tabs.
- History = reconstructed from saved substrate rows (no new schema/table);
  per-profile detail modal is lazy-loaded on open (DB-served, no API hit).
- No-spam honored: the only API hits are the explicit Check / per-box Refetch,
  both routed through the barrel's TTL/throttle gate; the page is a pure read.
- Server-only key use; access gated to admin + creator_manager (DAL +
  canAccessCreatorHub re-check in every action); audit-logged.
- Runtime missing-table guard (P2021/42P01) in read paths; "No account linked"/
  empty states per platform; house style (modern-panels), house-POV neutral
  info coloring (mentions = blue), no function props server->client, lazy.

Reads the linked Twitter handle from creator_socials (ADMIN DB) and pulls the
cached profile (pfp/name/@handle/followers/bio), latest tweets (text/time/
engagement), and the 7-day brand-mention count (packydotgg/@packydotgg/packygg/
packy.gg) via the @/lib/creator-hub barrel. Manual Refetch is the only forced
refresh (no auto-poll); everything else is served from the ADMIN-DB cache within
a TTL. "No account linked" empty state when no handle; "API key not configured"
state when the key is unset (server-only, never shown). Lazy (props: userId).

Runtime ensure-schema guard (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS on the twitter cache
tables, ADMIN DB) + every integration read try/caught so a missing table
(42P01/P2021) degrades to the empty state. House-POV: Twitter follower/
engagement stats are neutral social metrics, so blue/sky accents (no money
coloring); a brand mention is good for the house → emerald.

Integration parser already reads core+avatar (display_name from
legacy.name ?? core.name, avatar from legacy.profile_image_url_https ??
avatar.image_url) — no parser fix needed; this tab consumes the typed result.

Wiring into the tab bar + page.tsx is the separate Wire step (those files
untouched here to avoid collision).

entries.subject: feat(creator-hub): wire per-creator tabs (Creator/Risk/Forecast/Cohorts/Alts) into detail page
entries.body:
Make the Creator, Risk, Forecast, Cohorts & LTV, and Alt Accounts tabs
navigable on creators/[id] via ?tab=, replacing their "Soon" placeholders.
Only the active tab (resolved from ?tab=) mounts, inside a Suspense keyed on
the tab, so exactly one tab's data is ever fetched (active-tab-only /
never-preload); Overview stays the default and Sessions/Kick/Twitter remain
inert "Soon" placeholders for later waves.

- creator-tab-bar.tsx: client component (mirrors the insights/analytics tab
  strip) — live tabs render as <Link replace ?tab=> chips with pending state,
  highlighting the current tab; Sessions/Kick/Twitter stay non-navigating.
- page.tsx: read ?tab=, coerce unknown/Soon/missing -> overview, render the
  active tab lazily in <Suspense key={tab}>; RiskTab (async, no inner
  boundary) gets RiskTabSkeleton; others stream via their own inner Suspense.

Tab-key set is mirrored inline in the server page (NOT imported from the
client tab bar): a server import of a value from a Client Component throws at
render ("called a client function from the server"). The build passes either
way; this only surfaces at runtime — caught by a minted-session render check.

Verified: tsc + lint + next build green; minted admin session over the live
prod-read-only route renders all 6 tabs (HTTP 200, distinct per-tab content),
?tab=overview default + unknown-tab fallback work, and Sessions/Kick/Twitter
render inert with no link.

entries.subject: feat(creator-hub): Alt Accounts tab — collusion/self-boost detector
entries.body:
New self-contained creators/[id] tab that clusters a creator's affiliate-
code cohort by shared low-level signals to surface suspected alts boosting
the creator's leaderboard/stats:

- Signals (MAIN read-only, verified readable): shared IP (audit_events.ip +
  fingerprints.ip), shared /24 subnet, shared device (fingerprints.visitor_id),
  reused deposit wallet (ledger_transactions.source_address), synchronized
  deposits (same second), identical deposit amount+crypto, and the platform's
  own suspected_alt flag as corroboration.
- Union-find clusters edges into suspected-alt groups; per-cluster collusion
  flag fires on any hard signal / platform flag / >=2 distinct signals, with a
  0-100 risk score; worst-first ordering.
- PII safe: IPs and wallet addresses correlated server-side ONLY and rendered
  MASKED (1.2.3.x, bc1q...last4); raw values never reach the client or logs.
- LAZY: scan runs only when the tab opens, in its own Suspense boundary,
  cached (prod-pinned unstable_cache, 5m) + safeQuery timeout; every signal is
  best-effort and degrades to a reported data-gap instead of blanking.
- Graceful gap handling: probes for the fingerprints table and clearly flags
  device/fingerprint-IP/platform-alt-flag as unavailable when the snapshot
  lacks it (verify on prod) — the IP/wallet/timing/identical-deposit signals
  work regardless.

Component export: AltAccountsTab({ userId }) — wiring is a separate step
(creator-tab-bar.tsx / page.tsx left untouched).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

entries.subject: feat(creator-hub): Risk tab — wager-saving / perk-abuse detector
entries.body:
Per-referred-user wager-saving detector on creators/[id] (owner spec).
For each user under the creator's code: deposits, non-borrowed wager
(per game), expected house GGR (wager × blended edge — packs 10.8%,
battles 10.8%, upgrader 10%, weighted by the user's game mix), actual
realised house PnL (coverage-attributed deposits − attributed card/voucher
withdrawals — same per-user formula as the creator PnL panel), the
deviation gap, and a risk flag/score; worst-first, default flag at a 50%
shortfall.

Reuses the canonical creator attribution model (acu wager — borrow-
correction already baked in; covering-creator deposit reconstruction;
session-chain card withdrawals). Per-game split via acu.game_session_id
→ game_sessions.game_type. LAZY (scans only when the tab is opened),
cached prod-pinned + timeout-guarded; MAIN/prod game DB read-only.

DATA GAP (verified read-only on prod): the behavioural high-win-chance
(~90%) upgrader signal needs per-bet target-multiplier data, but upgrader
is not live on prod (game_type enum is {pack,battle}; no upgrader sessions;
no upgrader_games table). The signal box reports this honestly and
self-enables once upgrader ships (reads the canonical
provably_fair_results.result_metadata target multiplier). Low-variance
abuse is still caught by the expected-vs-actual PnL gap, which doesn't
depend on upgrader.

Self-contained component (props: userId/code) + _queries; not wired into
the tab bar yet (separate step).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

entries.subject: feat(creator-hub): API-key Settings page (Kick + Twitter RapidAPI keys)
entries.body:
Add a Creator-Hub Settings page to configure the third-party RapidAPI
keys the Hub uses to pull per-creator Kick + Twitter/X data. Keys are
stored in the ADMIN DB admin_settings key/value table under
integration_kick_rapidapi_key / integration_twitter_rapidapi_key
(reusing setAdminSetting), per the owner's "DB + settings page, not env"
spec.

SECURITY:
- Keys are secrets: written via a server action only; the stored value
  is NEVER returned to the client — the UI receives only a masked
  set/not-set state (last-4 preview), last-updated time, and the
  resolving editor name. A server-only module (server-only import)
  owns the raw read for server-to-server API calls.
- Access gated to the SAME rule as the Creator Hub itself
  (canAccessCreatorHub: founder motha, or a role whose ADMIN-DB toggle
  is on) on BOTH the page and the action; the action re-verifies the
  session + re-reads the live username/active flag from the ADMIN DB.
- Every set/clear is audit-logged via createAdminAuditEvent (key id +
  provider + action only — never the secret).

New: src/lib/integration-settings.ts, settings/page.tsx, settings/
actions.ts, settings/integration-keys-form.tsx. Wires a live "Settings"
item into the Creator-Hub sidebar.

Verified: tsc + lint + npm run build green; rendered live via minted
motha session — page loads (200, no redirect), both cards render,
save->mask->clear round-trip confirmed against the prod ADMIN DB with
the raw value absent from the client HTML and both audit rows written.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

entries.subject: feat(creator-hub): Cohorts & LTV tab for creators/[id]
entries.body:
Self-contained per-creator tab: the quality of a creator's referred
players over time — signup -> FTD -> repeat-deposit -> churn cohorts
(bucketed by signup month) + deposits-based LTV per cohort.

- _queries/cohorts-data.ts: single set-based MAIN read (read-only),
  bounded to a 365d signup lookback, correlated per-user rollups on
  indexed ledger/acu columns. Cached via unstable_cache (300s,
  prod-pinned like _pnl-cache.ts) + safeQuery timeout-guarded. Funnel
  defs reconcile with the existing creator queries (referred_by signup
  pool, total_deposited>0 FTD, >=2 completed deposits = repeat,
  no-deposit-in-30d = churn). Staff/creator + blacklist excluded.
  Lifetime net (deposits - cardWD) reused from getCreatorPnlCached as a
  creator-wide total (per-cohort net split isn't queryable) — labeled.
- _components/cohorts-chart.tsx: client recharts ComposedChart (grouped
  funnel bars + deposits-LTV line), matches the sibling activity-chart
  style. Serializable props only — no function props across RSC.
- _components/cohorts-ltv-tab.tsx: server component (props: userId),
  lazy keyed Suspense, KPI roll-up + chart + per-cohort table +
  honest footnotes. House-POV colors (deposits emerald, funnel counts
  neutral, churn rose, net emerald/rose).

LAZY: fetches only when the tab is opened. No page.tsx/tab-bar wiring
(separate step). Verified: tsc/lint/build green; cohort SQL run
read-only against live creators (correct funnel + LTV, 156ms, index
access, staff correctly excluded).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

entries.subject: feat(creator-hub): Forecast tab — deal-profitability projection (1w/2w/1m)
entries.body:
Build the per-creator Forecast tab for creators/[id]: projects whether the
creator's deal stays profitable for the HOUSE over 1 week / 2 weeks / 1 month,
driven by his CURRENT realized wager rate + realized PnL AND the deal stats
(withdraw cap + leaderboard funding × house% + tip/sponsor allowance), using
the owner's Profitable Algo math (Generated Value = wager × 0.075; Deal Spend =
caps + LB + tips/sponsor; Rate of Return = value/spend → profitable when > 1).

- Self-contained, LAZY: ForecastTab(userId) streams in its own Suspense; its
  data runs only when the tab is opened (active-tab-only / never-preload).
- Reuses existing read-only MAIN queries (creator PnL per-window, deal data,
  leaderboard cost ×house%, session-derived tips/sponsor) — no new MAIN scan,
  no MAIN write, no schema change.
- House-POV colors: generated value emerald, deal spend rose, RoR≥1 emerald.
- No fabrication: missing wager history / no deal degrade to clearly-labelled
  estimate states with explicit notes; recharts comparison + per-span verdict
  cards + an assumptions breakdown of the two halves the forecast is built from.
- Client recharts leaf takes serializable props only (no function props over
  the RSC boundary).

New files only; does not touch creator-tab-bar.tsx / page.tsx (wiring is a
separate step). tsc + lint + npm run build all green.
